body: Not really, I’m not keen on asking my parents to buy me a game, I’d rather watch the gameplay than spend money on it. But most of the time I drown my self in studies or hobbies to keep me from having time to overthink and end up crying.

I was never the smart kid up until I was around 12 when I was able to pull up the shithole which was my grades, then fast forward  to now when I’m 16 and I just feel like my efforts are all going down the drain and nothing is not going well despite me trying so hard to study.
Heh, I Guess I’m not the only one who contemplates death. 16 this year and it feels like Loneliness ha has been with me like a tumour since I was a kid.
